meta.title: Add a surrogate bid on an upcoming RFQ
gaps: Enter or verify the "Surrogate Bid Reference" value "Phone quote 27 Oct"
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enter or verify the "Surrogate Bid Reference" value "Phone quote 27 Oct"

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ directly on its Participants tab as the buyer.
Find the named vendor's participant row.
Assert that Add Bid is offered for Vendor A before the RFQ starts.
Submit the buyer's surrogate bid of 95 for every line to test whether the product permits it before start.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
